Hero.description: KivuLingua AI is an open scientific initiative creating high-quality multilingual speech and text datasets for Bantu languages of Eastern DRC. We develop advanced ASR and TTS models while strengthening linguistic sovereignty, digital inclusion, and cultural heritage preservation through community collaboration.

community.description: Native speakers of targeted Bantu languages in Eastern DRC engaged in community-driven data collection, validation and linguistic preservation.

languages.description: Bantu languages from North Kivu, South Kivu and Maniema prioritized for ASR, TTS and multilingual AI infrastructure.

audio.description: High-quality multilingual audio corpus planned with controlled speech, spontaneous conversations, oral traditions and community dialogue.

open.description: Fully open datasets, models and benchmarks following Mozilla Common Voice standards and international research ethics principles.

Research.title: Scientific Infrastructure for African Language Technologies
Research.description: KivuLingua AI develops advanced ASR and TTS systems using open-source frameworks: Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech), SpeechBrain, and Coqui TTS. We evaluate performance through Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and comparative benchmarking. Our research prioritizes ethical data collection, community ownership, and integration with international open-science ecosystems including Hugging Face and Mozilla Common Voice.

Community.title: Collaborative Infrastructure for Digital Linguistic Sovereignty
Community.description: Community participation anchors all KivuLingua AI initiatives. We engage native speakers, teachers, cultural leaders, local radio stations and religious institutions in participatory data collection following international ethical research standards. Linguistic communities co-govern datasets, validate transcriptions, and ensure cultural appropriateness. We prioritize informed consent, data anonymization, and community benefit-sharing while building sustainable African-led AI ecosystems.

Roadmap.title: Strategic Expansion: Building African-Led Language AI Infrastructure
Roadmap.description: KivuLingua AI advances iteratively through participatory phases, prioritizing foundation-building, model development, infrastructure scaling, and ecosystem integration. Each milestone expands linguistic coverage, technical capacity, community engagement and institutional partnerships while maintaining commitment to open science, ethical data practices and digital sovereignty for East Congolese language communities.
